request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Input is only a reference for premium tactile depth. Create a completely reimagined, flat orthographic full-screen mobile app UI for Buki, not a product photograph and not a physical room. The image canvas itself is the app screen, edge to edge, with no phone bezel, walls, floor, furniture, gallery, pedestal, perspective scene or environment. Design Buki as a calm modern children's art museum interface. Exact text "Buki" in a chunky refined wordmark at upper left. Replace the old line and flower with a dotted gallery path that turns one rounded corner and ends in an abstract four-petal pinwheel made from rounded diamonds. Compose a large portrait blank drawing board centered within the UI: slim teal left binding rail, layered warm-white paper, visible precise dot grid, double rounded artwork-safe frame, tiny colored registration dots outside the frame, and three small vertical selector tabs attached to the rail. Keep generous cream negative space. Place a restrained teal circular camera control at lower right within the app layout. Palette: deep teal #0D6F73, clay #E8735A, butter #F3CC5A, cornflower #6E93D6, moss #7DA36A, warm stone #F3EBDD, paper #FFFDF6. Sophisticated editorial spacing softened like a premium toy, child-friendly but not juvenile, feasible in Expo/Skia. Blank page. Exact readable text only "Buki". No extra words, no character illustration, no photorealistic scene.
